answer:
Freshman applicants must submit the following documents:
- Report Card (DepEd Form 138) or its equivalent (Form 137)
- NCAE results
- Physical and medical examination certified by a government physician (fitness to do University work)
- Certificate of good moral character from the school last attended
- Three latest 2x2 pictures
- Photocopy of authenticated birth certificate (NSO)
